Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Coastline is kicking off a focused encryption evidence pull for our SOC 2 / CAIQ review and we need a compact bundle from Redwood covering the following items:

- A current KMS operator access reconciliation: CSV (operator id, role, last auth time, hashed identity), and a concise description of operator separation controls.
- A signed transport narrative that explains wrapping/unwrapping processes for tenant KEKs, cross-region transit protections, and how ephemeral keys are evacuated during incident drills (we need a signature from an authorized Redwood security lead).
- A keystore snapshot (directory listing + checksums) demonstrating the keystore state for the last successful rotation window.
- Any existing HSM attestation or CAIQ/SIG references that map to the above artifacts.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these as an encrypted package and a DocuSign-signed narrative? Our deadline for the initial intake is Friday 7 May EOD (we will treat the materials as confidential). If you have an internal owner for each artifact, please include contact info and an expected delivery date.

Thanks — appreciate a short note of next steps.

Oliver

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and open a 30-minute call Tuesday to run through any final mapping to your SOC 2 control IDs.
